answer_1.quote: Automatic lyrics generation is a challenging language generation task for any musical genre, requiring story development and creativity while adhering to the structural constraints of song lyrics.
datasets: 60k English rap lyrics provided by Musixmatch

answer_2.quote: We conduct an automatic evaluation of RAP-FORMER, using the test sets of each of our three datasets. Our focus is on measuring two components that are important for generating fluent conditional rap verses: preserving content from the input text to the output, and maintaining rhyming fluency during generation.

answer_4.quote: Due to the limitations of automatic metrics for text generation, we also perform four human evaluation experiments using three raters, who are trained to translate lyrics.
answer_4.guideline: Each rater inspected 100 verses produced by either the RAPFORMER, or the two IR baselines, answering the following three questions: 1. How much do the lyrics presented resemble rap lyrics? On a scale from 1 (not at all), to 5 (this could be from existing rap lyrics), which measures the capacity of our models to preserve the Style. 2. How well do the lyrics preserve the content of the original news article on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 5 (very well)? This question measures the meaning preservation of our models (Meaning). 3. Do these lyrics look like a song you know (yes or no)?
